statement: With the poor-fiber tail, Paper C's contagion recursion needs only two productions, and they reach the depth-two ceiling. Taking the OE family over all of A cap (x^(3/8), x^(3/4)] rather than over the rest -- legitimate because the E-images are even and the OE-images odd, which is the only disjointness ever used -- Corollary of J-oe-poor-fiber-tail at V = x^(3/8), whose error x^(-1/8) is the shape Lemma 4.3 already contributes, gives g_A(t) >= (1-eps_1) g_A(t/2) + (1/3 - (2/3)eta_0 - eps_7) g_A(3t/4) - eps_8. By Lemma 5.1 this reaches every lambda with 2^(-lambda) + (1/3 - (2/3)eta_0)(3/4)^lambda > 1, whose supremum as eta_0 -> 0 is the root of 2^(-lambda) + (1/3)(3/4)^lambda = 1, lambda_ideal = 0.4926579801, above the published lambda** = 0.4925715447; break-even is eta_0 = 8.60e-5. WHAT LEAVES THE CRITICAL PATH, which is the whole value: Proposition 4.4 and its two exponential-sum bounds, Paper C's largest unformalized gap; the six-word ladder and Appendix D; and the STATEMENTS of Lemmas 4.1, 4.1' and 4.2, since the new argument needs no goodness hypothesis and no pointwise floor -- one step of Lemma 4.2's proof is retained, the step interval [A_m, B_m] that defines alpha_m and eta_m, but the sweep lemmas themselves are not used. WHAT DOES NOT MOVE: the supremum is approached and not attained, eta_0 being fixed before x, exactly as the published statement is; u_0 is astronomical at the eta_0 that beats lambda**, so t_1 is about 221 and the implied constant K is tiny; Theorem 7.2 stays conditional; no cycle is excluded and no orbit is shown to reach 1. Paper C is not edited here -- that manuscript is claimed by another session. LEAN, 20 September 2026, end to end, in Problems/Juggler/FatePoorProduction.lean, all kernel-checked on [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. family_OE_averaged is Family 3 at the averaged coefficient (2/3)(1/2 - eta_0): FateProduction.family_OE with the per-fibre bound nonpoor_fiber_logMass_ge in place of good_fiber_logMass_ge and the exceptional set poor_logMass_le in place of bad_logMass_le, everything structural the original's. production_two_averaged is the production inequality at that coefficient, with production_two's shell geometry inlined and one new hypothesis hT: 3(1280/eta_0^2 + 1) <= e^(t/8), which is Lemma 2's two block conditions rewritten at U = floor(e^(3t/8)) and is the whole cost of averaging. contagion_averaged runs recursion_lemma, which was already generic in coefficients, rates and errors, so Lemma 5.1 is not restated; it is parametric in lambda and eta_0 with zeta(lambda, eta_0) > 0 as a hypothesis, which is the shape of the mathematics -- the supremum approached and not attained. zeta2avg_pos is a separate arithmetic certificate at lambda = 100/203 = 0.4926108, eta_0 = 10^-5, by two rational bounds at the 203rd power; 100/203 is chosen for margin, not minimality: 67/136 also lies strictly between lambda** and lambda_ideal and has the smaller denominator, but leaves only 6.3e-6 of zeta at eta_0 = 0 against 2.71e-5 here, so it would force a tenfold smaller eta_0 and sharper rational bounds for no gain; 33/67 falls just short of lambda** outright. oe_rest_average.exponent_certificate re-derives the whole certificate in exact arithmetic, including the enumeration of smaller denominators. logMass_contagion_averaged is therefore Theorem 5.3 above the published lambda**, unconditionally. The Tao threshold follows it down: conjecture_of_tao_rate_averaged needs e > 103/203 = 0.50739, where the unconditional conjecture_of_tao_rate needs e > 27/40 and Paper C's conditional form needs e > 0.51 -- the unconditional threshold is now below the manuscript's conditional one. conjecture_of_cylinder_averaged is Corollary 8.4 at the same exponent. FateProduction is NOT edited: it is a Paper C input pinned by the release manifest and its 2/9 chain is what the manuscript cites, so this is a parallel statement on a different range of m. The anti-duplication objection that stopped an earlier attempt here was overstated -- formalpedia's habit prevents two NAMED declarations stating one fact, which splits a citation; inlined proof steps inside one proof cost maintenance and create no ambiguous citation target. An OE fiber can be unbalanced only by locking onto a rational step of small denominator, and the quantitative form is elementary. For m >= 10^6 and every convergent denominator q of alpha_m = {(3/2) m^(2/3)}, |G_m/H_m - 1/2| <= 4||q alpha_m|| + 5/(2q) + 3.77 q/H_m. PROOF: cut the fiber into blocks of q consecutive members; by Lemma 4.2's step interval [A_m, B_m] each block is a translate of the 1/q grid perturbed by at most ||q alpha_m|| + q eta_m, a 1/q grid splits a half-circle within 1/2 of evenly, and at most 2 eps q + 1 of its points sit within eps of a given point, so the block's good count is within 4 eps q + 5/2 of q/2. The constant 3.77 is 1 + 4 sup(eta_m H_m) with sup = 0.6903 at m = 10^6 from Lemmas 3.2 and 4.2. Unlike Lemma 4.2 this uses neither monotone steps nor alpha_m <= 1/2 nor any goodness hypothesis, so it holds on EVERY fiber, and it is one fiber at a time with no averaging over m. VERIFIED at every convergent denominator q <= H_m over four windows at 10^6, 10^7, 10^8 and 10^9: least slack 0.233, and eta_m H_m at most 0.6834 against the 0.6903 assumed. The 5/(2q) term is not slack: a fiber locked at q = 3 has share near 1/3, which is J-oe-fiber-pairing-third-is-attained. LEAN, 20 September 2026: BlockLock.block_lock, kernel-checked on standard axioms, in the un-divided form |G - H/2| <= 4(rho + q eta)H + 5H/(2q) + q. The two grid counts are grid_half_count and grid_near_count; gridRes_mul_inj and grid_reindex are where gcd(p,q) = 1 earns its place. IN PAPER C SINCE THE REVISION OF 2026-09-21: Lemma 5.14.

The OE fibers whose parity share is bounded away from 1/2 have finite total logarithmic mass, so no set can concentrate on them. For eta_0 in (0,1/2], with P_eta0 = {m : |G_m/H_m - 1/2| >= eta_0} and u_0(eta_0) = max(10^6, (1950/eta_0^2)^3): #(P_eta0 cap (u,2u]) <= 430 u^(2/3)/eta_0^2 for u >= u_0, and sum over m in P_eta0, m > U of 1/m <= 2100 U^(-1/3)/eta_0^2 for U >= u_0. PROOF: the block lock J-oe-fiber-block-lock, taken at the largest convergent denominator below eta_0 H_m/16, forces q <= 3.77/eta_0 with ||q alpha_m|| <= 32/(eta_0 H_m); then Lemma 4.3's arc count with its two goodness arcs replaced by the Q(Q+1)/2 arcs of total length 2 Q delta. No exponential sum, no Vaaler approximation, no second-derivative test: continued fractions and counting. COROLLARY, and the point of it: for EVERY set S of integers above V -- no backward closure, no structure -- sum_{m in S} (1/m)(G_m/H_m) >= (1/2 - eta_0) sum_{m in S} 1/m - 1050 V^(-1/3)/eta_0^2. This is what juggler_oe_rest_average was parked for: the park rested on the poor set's mass RELATIVE to A, which the census could not control, and the theorem makes that quantity irrelevant. The constants are crude; the exponent 1/3 is not, and nothing downstream is sensitive to its value, only to its positivity. Census finds the true density of the share <= 0.40 fibers between 1.4 and 2.1 times u^(-1/3) on [10^5, 10^8], and every one of them locks at q in {1,3,5} with ||q alpha_m|| H_m <= 1.99. CONSTANT CORRECTED ON FORMALIZING, 20 September 2026: the first write-up said 420 and 2040. It had assumed Lemma 3's second term was the Gauss sum Q(Q+1)/2; the Lean count delivers Q(Q+1), because arc_count_le counts a half-open arc while ||q A_m|| <= delta is closed, so each of the Q arcs is widened by one point. That is 18/eta_0^2 against 8.99/eta_0^2, the sum is 481.71/eta_0^2, and 0.8825 u^(2/3) times it is 425.11 -- above 420. Lean: FiberParity.poor_count_le', kernel-checked at 430, with the tail at 2100. Nothing downstream moves, since only the positivity of the exponent is ever used. LEAN, 20 September 2026: the whole chain is kernel-checked on standard axioms.
